echo_handler_idempotency.verdict: GREEN — handlers are re-fetch by construction, plus correlation-id dedupe

correlation_id_dedupe.storage: sessionStorage (per-tab, key foodking_correlation_dedupe_v1) with debounced 250ms write + pagehide synchronous flush
correlation_id_dedupe.scope_caveat: Per-tab dedupe by design — eventContract.js:88-94 explicitly documents: 'sessionStorage is per-tab; dedupe is NOT shared across browser tabs. Each tab maintains its own window. Cross-tab dedupe would require BroadcastChannel + localStorage and is out of scope.' Acceptable: each tab independently dedupes its own seen events; no risk of double-handle within a tab; cross-tab double-handle is the natural cost of having 2 listeners on the same Pusher channel and is harmless because handlers are idempotent re-fetches.

per_handler_idempotency_audit.handler_action: _debouncedRefresh() — full GET refresh, idempotent by construction. ItemAvailabilityChanged also dispatches into kdsInflight store (10min TTL lazy purge, mutation idempotent).
this.list() refetch — idempotent. _markNewReady has explicit anti-double-fire guard via _echoMarkedReady Set (lines 269-277) so OSS Echo→list() cascade doesn't double-chime.
loadKioskCashOrders + loadActiveOrdersStats + loadReadyOrders — all idempotent GET refresh. _notifyNewOrder protected by destroyed-guard (line 2672).
Cache invalidation + re-fetch — idempotent. CatalogChange runs through useCatalogChangeNotifier composable which shows a toast (single-fire by composable contract).
Polling cycle re-runs immediately — idempotent. AUDIT-P2-G guard at line 299 prevents overlapping poll on Echo+interval collision.

echo_handler_idempotency.global_guard: On every Echo subscribe, all components call unsubscribeEcho() first to prevent duplicate listeners on re-mount — pattern documented as [AUDIT-52-BUG2] / [AUDIT-P51-BUG2]

Auto-transition (KdsV2Grid.vue:235-249) compensates — when chef on either station bumps the last item, the watcher fires onV2AutoPromote → PATCH → backend → broadcast → both stations re-sync the order status.

session_inconsistency_risks.title: No 'storage' event listener — cross-tab logout not propagated
session_inconsistency_risks.scenario: Admin opens Tab A + Tab B. Tab A clicks Logout → authLogout mutation → state.authToken=null → vuex-persistedstate flushes to localStorage → 'storage' event fires on Tab B → NO LISTENER, Tab B keeps in-memory authToken. Tab B continues to operate until next axios call → server replies 401 (token revoked by /auth/logout endpoint) → axios interceptor (app.js:171-176) sets _401Handling guard, dispatches logout, redirects to /login. Window: between logout-click on A and first axios call on B (could be minutes if B is idle on a static screen).
session_inconsistency_risks.impact: LOW security risk — server has revoked the token so no privileged action can succeed silently. UX gap: Tab B may show stale data and only learn about logout when user interacts.
session_inconsistency_risks.v2_saas_recommendation: Add window.addEventListener('storage', e => if(e.key==='vuex' && parsed.auth.authStatus===false) router.push('/login'))

session_inconsistency_risks.title: Same user, 2 admin tabs editing same item — no optimistic lock
session_inconsistency_risks.scenario: Admin Tab A loads /admin/items/42, Admin Tab B loads same item. A saves change → CatalogChanged broadcast → B receives via Echo → useCatalogChangeNotifier shows toast (kiosk path) BUT admin items page does not subscribe to CatalogChanged (no _subscribeEcho in ItemShowComponent / ItemListComponent / AvailabilityToggleComponent / CatalogStudioComponent — verified). B saves stale form 30s later → A's changes silently overwritten.
session_inconsistency_risks.impact: LOW for V1 Le Cayenne (single-admin operational reality). HIGH for V2 SaaS multi-tenant.
session_inconsistency_risks.mitigations_in_place: CatalogChanged broadcast exists for catalog projection invalidation; AvailabilityToggleComponent uses targeted PATCH on availability only, not full item edit

session_inconsistency_risks.title: Pos cart in-memory divergence between 2 POS tabs same user
session_inconsistency_risks.scenario: Cashier opens 2 POS tabs. Tab A adds item → localStorage write fires 'storage' on Tab B → no listener → Tab B's in-memory Vuex state stays empty. Cashier finishes order on Tab A → posCart/resetCart clears storage → Tab B in-memory state still shows the deleted lines.
session_inconsistency_risks.impact: LOW — cashier physical workflow uses 1 POS tab at a time; in-memory divergence resolves on Tab B's next reload/scope-change. PaymentComponent uses backend-validated PricingService.calculateOrder so wrong cart cannot mint a wrong fiscal_sequence_no.
session_inconsistency_risks.v1_le_cayenne_assessment: Theoretical — no real-world report of cashier using 2 POS tabs at Le Cayenne

session_inconsistency_risks.title: Echo bandwidth — 10 tabs same user subscribed to same branch.{id} channel
session_inconsistency_risks.scenario: Owner has 10 admin tabs open on same machine, all subscribed to branch.1. Pusher Channels protocol opens 1 WebSocket connection per Echo instance, and 1 Echo instance per tab. 10 WS connections × ~50 events/min = 500 inbound messages/min per browser session.
session_inconsistency_risks.impact: LOW — Pusher Channels free tier handles 200 concurrent connections per app; Le Cayenne has 1 branch + small staff count. Bandwidth ~negligible. activityTimeout 30s + pongTimeout 5s (bootstrap.js:341-342) keep idle connections alive without storms.
session_inconsistency_risks.v2_saas_recommendation: Migrate to shared SharedWorker + BroadcastChannel relay to fan-out 1 WS per origin

adversarial_findings.result: AMBER — Tab B's in-memory token is stale until next axios round-trip. Server-side token IS revoked (LoginController.php:155 user.tokens.where(name=auth_token).delete() on /logout). First Tab B request returns 401 → axios interceptor handles. adversarial_findings.test: Tab A in offline mode → Tab B online → state diverge?
adversarial_findings.result: GREEN — Tab A's offline writes go to kioskOfflineQueue (IndexedDB) which IS multi-tab-safe via BroadcastChannel kiosk-offline-queue-sync. When Tab A comes back online, syncQueue acquires the cross-tab lock and replays. Tab B sees the resulting server-side state via Echo broadcast.

ACCEPTABLE — 10 WebSocket connections × ~50 events/min = 500 msg/min per browser. activityTimeout=30s + pongTimeout=5s. Pusher protocol multiplexes channel subscriptions over single connection per Echo instance. Le Cayenne real-world: ≤3 tabs typical.

SHARED via vuex-persistedstate localStorage key 'vuex'. Every tab on same origin reads the same token. Sanctum is stateless — token validity is checked server-side per request. No tab-isolation issue; logout from any tab revokes token for ALL tabs (server-side), each tab discovers the revocation on next axios call.
adversarial_findings.verified: bootstrap.js:313-323 selectSurfaceBearerToken reads localStorage; axios-setup.js:34-58 builds Authorization Bearer header from same source

adversarial_findings.test: Two chefs bump the same item simultaneously
adversarial_findings.result: GREEN — bump is local-only (per-tab kds.bumped_items_v1). Each tab independently triggers auto-transition watcher. First tab to fire onV2ChangeStatus PATCH wins via backend lockForUpdate. Second tab's PATCH gets 409 (IdempotencyKeyConflict OR InvalidTransition ACCEPT→PREPARING when already PREPARING) → silently swallowed → _debouncedRefresh re-syncs to backend truth.

adversarial_findings.test: Admin Tab A toggles item 86 OFF, Tab B toggles same item 86 OFF
adversarial_findings.result: GREEN — ItemAvailabilityChanged is the canonical event; both PATCHes serialize backend-side, ItemBranchAvailability has a unique (item_id, branch_id) constraint. Second PATCH is no-op (same state). Broadcast fires both times; correlation dedupe skips the second on each subscribed tab.

adversarial_findings.test: Cashier encaisses kiosk-cash order, admin in another tab marks same order REFUNDED
adversarial_findings.result: GREEN — backend OrderStateMachine enforces transition rules. REFUNDED requires PAID prerequisite. If cashier wins lockForUpdate first → PAID succeeds, admin's REFUNDED then succeeds. If admin somehow refunds first (impossible: REFUNDED from PENDING_COUNTER is not a valid transition) → cashier sees 409/422 with state machine message.

verdict_rationale: Backend-mediated state coherence is GREEN (K2-HEAL-01 healed, KDS multi-bump race verified, IdempotencyKeyMiddleware scopes by branch+user+key, Echo broadcasts fan-out to all tabs, every handler is an idempotent re-fetch). Frontend-mediated cross-tab UX has DESIGNED-IN per-tab gaps: no 'storage' event listener, no cross-tab logout sync, no optimistic locking on admin item edits, KDS bump map is intentionally local-only with UI notice. The gaps are all (a) acknowledged in code comments, (b) compensated by backend invariants (lockForUpdate, state machine, Echo refresh), (c) low-impact for V1 Le Cayenne single-restaurant single-admin operational reality. For V2 SaaS multi-tenant rollout, recommended additions: window.addEventListener('storage') for cross-tab auth sync, If-Match/version_id optimistic lock on admin item PATCH, SharedWorker for Echo fan-out. None of these are V1 ship blockers — the mission specifies 'physical walks may run 5 surfaces simultaneously' and the audit confirms that scenario works because each surface (admin / POS / KDS / OSS / Kiosk preview) is on a different page route with its own Echo subscription, and conflicting writes are serialized backend-side via lockForUpdate + 409 conflict.
